name: @myzonerocks/gossmark
description: The engine behind the checkmark: credentials, an offline trust chain, and scoped delegation that never touches a handle.

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:js
scripts.build:core: cd ../.. && zig build wasm -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && mkdir -p sdk/ts/wasm && cp zig-out/wasm/gossmark.wasm sdk/ts/wasm/gossmark.wasm
